name: qlrisk_price_fx_digital_option
title: Price a FXDigitalOption
description:
Price one FX Digital Option (qlrisk FXDigitalOption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 461,853.15 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
